lead: The options show one verb as -ing, -ed, base form or noun, such as attach, attaching, attached, attachment. The noun being described decides between -ing and -ed.
選項是同一個動詞的 -ing、-ed、原形和名詞，例如 attach、attaching、attached、attachment。被修飾的名詞決定用 -ing 還是 -ed。
steps: Find the noun the blank describes.
Ask whether that noun does the action or receives it. Doing is -ing, receiving is -ed.
問這個名詞是做動作還是承受動作。做動作用 -ing，承受用 -ed。
If the blank opens the sentence, the subject after the comma should be the one doing or receiving the action.
空格在句首時，逗號後面的主詞要是做或承受這個動作的人或物。

head: Before a noun
放在名詞前
body: A noun that does the action takes -ing: the remaining seats. A noun that receives the action takes -ed: the attached file.
名詞主動做動作用 -ing（the remaining seats），名詞被動承受用 -ed（the attached file）。
ex: Please review the attached file before the meeting.
開會前請先看附件。
The remaining seats will be sold at the door.
剩下的座位將在門口販售。

head: After a noun
放在名詞後
body: A participle phrase after a noun works like a short relative clause: the employees attending = the employees who attend. Use it when the sentence already has a main verb.
名詞後面的分詞片語相當於簡短的關係子句：the employees attending = the employees who attend。句子已經有主要動詞時用它。
ex: The employees attending the training should arrive early.
參加訓練的員工應提早到。
The products manufactured in Vietnam are shipped weekly.
在越南製造的產品每週出貨。
Anyone wishing to attend should register by Friday.
想參加的人請在星期五前報名。

head: A phrase that opens the sentence
放在句首的分詞片語
body: Its subject is the subject of the main clause. If that subject does the action, use -ing. If it receives the action, use -ed.
它的主詞就是主句的主詞。主詞主動做用 -ing，被動承受用 -ed。
ex: When filling out the form, please use black ink.
填寫表格時，請使用黑色墨水。
Founded in 1998, Norland Tech now has offices in six countries.
Norland Tech 成立於 1998 年，現在在六個國家設有辦公室。
Once approved, the request will be forwarded to the finance team.
申請一經核准，就會轉給財務團隊。

head: Having + past participle
完成式分詞
body: It shows that the action finished before the main verb. The subject of the main clause did it.
表示這個動作在主要動詞之前已經完成，做這個動作的是主句的主詞。
ex: Having reviewed the proposal, the board decided to fund the project.
董事會審閱提案後，決定資助這個計畫。

head: Feeling verbs: thing or person
情緒動詞：事物或人
body: Use -ing for the thing that causes the feeling. Use -ed for the person who has the feeling: the results were disappointing, customers were disappointed.
造成感覺的事物用 -ing，有這種感覺的人用 -ed：results 是 disappointing，customers 是 disappointed。
ex: The quarterly results were encouraging.
季度成果令人振奮。
Most customers were satisfied with the new service.
大部分顧客對新服務感到滿意。

head: Participles that act as adjectives
當形容詞用的分詞
body: Attached, enclosed, revised, updated, scheduled, detailed, qualified and experienced are -ed adjectives. Attached and enclosed can also open a sentence: Enclosed is a copy.
attached、enclosed、revised、updated、scheduled、detailed、qualified、experienced 是 -ed 形容詞。attached、enclosed 也可以放句首。
ex: Enclosed is a copy of the signed contract.
隨函附上一份已簽署的合約。
We hired an experienced technician to repair the equipment.
我們請了一位有經驗的技師來修理設備。

pairs.right: Anyone wishing to attend should register.
pairs.wrong: Anyone wished to attend should register.
why: The person is the one who wishes, so the participle is active: -ing.
想參加的人是主動想要，所以用 wishing。

pairs.right: Enclosed is the invoice for your order.
pairs.wrong: Enclosing is the invoice for your order.
why: The invoice is the thing that is enclosed, so it takes the -ed form.
發票是被附上的東西，要用過去分詞。

pairs.right: The presentation was confusing, so many people were confused.
pairs.wrong: The presentation was confused, so many people were confusing.
why: A thing that causes the feeling takes -ing. People who feel it take -ed.
簡報讓人困惑，用 -ing；人感到困惑，用 -ed。

traps: The subject of an opening participle phrase should match the main subject. In the sentence beginning When reviewing the report, errors were found, errors cannot review, so it is wrong.
句首分詞片語的主詞要和主句主詞相同。When reviewing the report, errors were found 是錯的，因為 errors 不會自己審閱。
A participle does not show time by itself. The attached file is not being attached now. Decide by active or passive, not by time.
分詞本身不表示時間。the attached file 不是「正在被附上」。要看主動或被動，不是看時間。
If the sentence already has a main verb and no conjunction, the blank cannot be another finite verb. Look for a participle that describes the noun.
句子已經有主要動詞、也沒有連接詞時，空格就不能再放一個動詞，要找修飾名詞的分詞。
